items.title_kr: Macy's, 강력한 earnings 발표 및 2026년 guidance 상향 조정
items.title_en: Macy's reports stronger earnings and higher 2026 guidance
items.body_kr: Macy's가 시장 예상을 웃도는 견조한 실적을 기록하며 2026년 full-year guidance를 상향 조정했습니다. 어려운 market 상황 속에서도 건전한 comp와 margin 방어력을 보여준 점이 vendor의 향후 reorder 및 sourcing 전략에 긍정적 시그널을 줍니다.
items.body_en: Macy's reported stronger earnings and raised its 2026 full-year guidance, demonstrating resilient comps and margin control in a tough market. This performance signals steady inventory reorder potential for vendor partners.

items.title_kr: Abercrombie와 Hollister, legacy mall brand의 새로운 성공 공식 제시
items.title_en: How Abercrombie and Hollister Are Rewriting the Rules for Legacy Mall Brands
items.body_kr: Abercrombie and Hollister are leading a retail turnaround for legacy mall brands through successful product repositioning and Gen Z targeting. Their elevated merchandise and category expansion beyond Y2K trends offer key retail benchmarking.

items.title_kr: Macy's, DoorDash delivery partnership 확대 및 패션 retail 위상 재정립
items.title_en: DoorDash adds Macy's, Anthropologie, Vans, Timberland, North Face
items.body_kr: Macy's expanded its digital reach by partnering with DoorDash for on-demand delivery, strengthening store-based fulfillment. This omnichannel retail channel expansion helps drive faster sell-through for vendor merchandise.

items.title_kr: Kohl's, 추가 25% 할인 및 무료 배송을 포함한 한정 promotion 전개
items.title_en: Shop the rare Kohl's sale for additional 25% off and free shipping
items.body_kr: Kohl's launched a rare promotional event featuring an extra 25% discount and free shipping to drive traffic. This aggressive pricing move aims to accelerate end-of-season inventory turnover.

items.title_kr: Kohl's, 신발 category 실적 호조에 힘입어 상품 믹스 강화
items.title_en: How Footwear Is on the Upswing at Kohl’s
items.body_kr: Kohl's footwear category is showing a steady sales upswing, acting as a key performance driver. Vendors should align their reorder strategies with these strong category trends.

items.title_kr: Levi's, Macy's 100주년 Thanksgiving Day Parade 공식 파트너 참여
items.title_en: Levi's Gets In On Macy's Centennial Thanksgiving Parade
items.body_kr: Levi's has joined Macy's Centennial Thanksgiving Parade as an official partner to kick off holiday marketing. Major brand tie-ins with holiday events are key catalysts for seasonal merchandise demand.

items.title_kr: KnitWell Group, Ann Taylor 모회사 디지털 및 고객 데이터 총괄 임원 선임
items.title_en: KnitWell Group names chief digital and customer data officer
items.body_kr: Ann Taylor parent KnitWell Group appointed a new chief digital and customer data officer to sharpen its digital and data strategies. This leadership change aims to boost E-commerce personalization ahead of the holiday season.

items.title_kr: Hallmark, Disney Christmas Movie Collection을 Kohl's와 Walmart 등에 독점 공개
items.title_en: Hallmark Announces Disney Christmas Movie Collection Coming to Walmart, Kohl’s, and More
items.body_kr: Hallmark announced a Disney Christmas Movie Collection heading to major retail channels including Kohl's and Walmart. IP-driven holiday exclusive merchandise is expected to be a major traffic driver for the season.

items.title_kr: Pair of Thieves, 주요 언더웨어 품평회에서 우수 제품으로 선정
items.title_en: After Testing 30 Pairs of Boxer Briefs, These Are Our Favorites
items.body_kr: Pair of Thieves' boxer briefs ranked among top favorites in a comprehensive underwear product test. This recognized quality and comfort reinforces its strong competitive positioning across wholesale channels.

items.title_kr: 올해 Holiday 시즌 소비자들, 선물 외 필수품 비축 경향 뚜렷
items.title_en: Consumers aren’t just buying gifts this holiday season. They’re stocking up on essentials.
items.body_kr: Consumers are expected to stock up on essentials alongside holiday gifts this season, driven by value-seeking behavior. Vendors should focus on practical merchandise assortments and strategic pricing.
